contentPattern: One row per image. Each row: cell 1 image (picture), cell 2 asset title (plain text, optional; falls back to the image alt), cell 3 download links (High-Res / Low-Res; optional). Download, favourite (add to cart) and share actions are generated from the title and links via media-actions.

optionNotes.default: Full-width hero image on black (max 500px tall) with the vertical download / favourite / share rail on the right edge.
optionNotes.thumbnail: Plain image; the first link in the row wraps the image as its target.
optionNotes.strip: Three-up row of 1.4:1 photos; a title and actions bar slides up on hover / focus.
optionNotes.gallery: 1 / 2 / 3 column grid of 16:9 tiles with an actions overlay on hover / focus.

usage.description: Press-release and image-pack pages: the article hero photo with its action rail, a row of downloadable press photos, image-pack grids and image thumbnails.

reuseGuidance: Use for any downloadable press image or set of images. For an image paired with article text use columns-press-image; for an image with an overlapping caption card use image-caption.
